showFloatingToolbar: Show floating toolbar when cursor is inside a table
showFloatingToolbarDesc: When enabled, a floating toolbar will appear near the cursor when editing a table, providing quick access to alignment, sorting, moving rows/columns, etc.
bindTabDesc: Press Tab in a table cell to jump to the next cell, and Shift+Tab to jump to the previous cell
bindEnterDesc: Press Enter in a table cell to jump to the same column in the next row, automatically inserting a new row if at the last row
fixCJKWidthDesc: Estimate width for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean double-byte characters to achieve perfectly aligned Markdown table formatting
